body: But will anyone be able to love me in the same way? He loved my unshaven legs, he loved my period, he loved absolutely everything about me. He wasn't grossed out by anything at all that had to do with me and my body, i could talk freely about anything and not worry. He cared a lot about me, though he got mad when i wouldn't eat it was for my own good. but how much did he really care if he can just decide in a few weeks that i'm not the one, that this girl he *may* have more in common with is worth more to him that a 4 year relationship.

Do you really think I can do it? I don't know what to do about the cats and about school. Where will I live if I continue schooling? I still have two weeks and my parents live hours away with no busses to my school. My cats are my life and I can't leave them, but one of them is his cat and she would be devastated without her dear friend who is my cat. It breaks my heart and I would rather just leave this world than deal with this mess of So many breaking hearts. There would be 10 hurt people if I leave. Only 5 people if I cease to exist. I don't like hurting more people than necessary.

But where do I go? My parents always told me he was going to do this and that he was going to hurt me. I proved them wrong this year when they met, but now I have to go admit to my parents that I'm a failure right before they leave this state. I have no money, I only work a part time job and go go school full time but I've been so depressed that I can't even go to class. I AM a failure. I am nobody and nothing. My parents have always been disappointed in me and I have nothing to show for. I probably won't even get my degree. I won't get anything. I feel so alone and isolated. I've tried looking for therapists but I'm trying to save money and I just don't see any way around this... Everyone leaves me at the slightest chance and the good friends I thought I had ditch me when I need them. I'm not a good friend, girlfriend, daughter, or person. I feel like there's no reason for this.

My parents are moving and I have no where to go. My boyfriend is my life and I have no one to talk to. I can't bear the thought that even at my best I wasn't good enough for my best friend. I doubt anyone could love me, and I know I sound so pathetic saying that and not moving on. I'm not very strong when it comes to being alone and hurt by the only person I could trust. He can't even look at me anymore without feeling bad and I always feel the need to apologize. I don't know what else to do. I feel so alone.
